summary: Iterates a scene-file array (dword_8AC490, stride 396) for a count held in dword_8AC488. For each non-empty entry it reads the filename string at entry+4, compares it against the base path in dword_7CE5D0 (falling back to the static byte_5EA438 string when that pointer is null) via sub_596C80, and breaks with the comparison result when a match (zero return) is found. If no entry matches before the count is exhausted it falls back to AIW(0).

local_names.v0: scene entry count loaded from dword_8AC488
local_names.v1: iteration index over the scene array
local_names.i: byte offset into the scene array, advanced 396 per entry
local_names.v3: strlen(filename) + 1, the length passed to the comparison
local_names.v4: base path pointer; dword_7CE5D0 or byte_5EA438 fallback

operations.description: Load the scene entry count into v0 from dword_8AC488 and reset the iteration index v1 to 0.
If dword_8AC488 <= 0, return AIW(0) immediately: no scene files to inspect.
Infinite for-loop stepping the array byte offset i by 396 per scene entry; the exit path is the explicit v1/v0 bound check.
Compute the filename string length: strlen of the string at scene entry + 4, plus 1 for the terminator.
Only test entries whose computed length minus 1 is greater than 0, i.e. non-empty filename strings.
Resolve the comparison base path: dword_7CE5D0, or the static byte_5EA438 string when that pointer is null.
Call sub_596C80 on the scene filename at entry+4 against the resolved base path with the computed length; a zero return (match) breaks the loop and is returned.
Fallback call AIW(0) when the index v1 reaches the count v0 with no match found.
Return the last comparison result (zero on match) or the AIW(0) fallback result when the loop is exhausted.
